name: wds_vtab-cifar100
description: A subset of CIFAR-100 packaged for use in the CLIP/VTAB-style visual transfer evaluations. It measures image classification and transfer learning performance on the CIFAR-100 categories when used as a downstream fine-tuning or linear-evaluation task. Useful for comparing vision model representations and zero-/few-shot classification ability on a standard 100-class object recognition problem.
reputation: A standard small-scale image-classification test used in representation learning and VTAB-style transfer evaluations, but not a premier large-scale benchmark by itself.
